rtr.text: Ruzi is the Master Trainer of the Selesnya Wolf Riders, who teaches his students to trust their wolves by crossing a high beam with his wolf Kuma without hesitation. After class, the dryad Mazena brings a message from Guildmaster Trostani, ordering him to leave that day for the Rubblebelt to find his sister Cecilee.

Ruzi recalls that Cecilee, mute from childhood, once spoke a beautiful recitation in praise of Selesnya, and the dryads called her a conduit to the Worldsoul. Feeling called to establish a settlement in the Rubblebelt, she ignored his warnings and led twenty followers there, where she adopted an abandoned Gruul child named for him.

Kuma smells blood and carries Ruzi through the shattered gate of the settlement, where he surprises Massacre Girl and her men. Massacre Girl refuses to say who hired her and leaves, and Ruzi and Kuma kill an ogre, with Ruzi beheading it in a murderous rage.

Ruzi buries the dead in a mass grave, including his sister, without looking at her, and resolves to break from Selesnya and make destroying Massacre Girl his purpose, since Trostani would not permit vengeance. He finds baby Zi alive in a hidden cradle and vows to tear down the city.
